content.text: This is ready for initial comment.
Moving this out of "Review" state for now. I will resume work on this after the 4.6.0 release is out.

I've put quite a bit of work into this, but I am giving up. This isn't going to happen during the month of December, and I have other responsibilities during the month of January/February. I would note that my interest in this ticket is entirely based on the prospect of re-using the kernel-api and http-api in an alternate implementation, but I'm am increasingly less confident that such re-use will even be possible, hence, I can't justify spending any more time on this – I've already spend nearly a month of work already. It would, IMO, be much more fruitful to simply greenfield an alt-implementation.
yes, that pretty much sums it up.
I'm closing this issue as part of a jira repository scrubbing.  It appears to be out of date, no longer applicable, or addressed by future versions of Fedora.

The Fedora codebase relies heavily on Guava Converter classes, especially for converting resource identifiers. This implementation, however, is verbose and confusing. This is a ticket to track the replacement of these Converter-based classes with a Fedora-specific interface.
